# Plan 01-01: Drive parameter

## Goal
A drive parameter exists in the APVTS, 0..100%, default 25%, and is automatable.

## Context
`Source/ParamIDs.h` holds every parameter ID as a constexpr string literal — add to it,
never retype the literal elsewhere. `Source/PluginProcessor.cpp` builds the APVTS layout.

## Tasks

<task id="1">
  <name>Add drive parameter ID and APVTS entry</name>
  <files>Source/ParamIDs.h, Source/PluginProcessor.cpp</files>
  <action>Declare ParamIDs::drive = "drive". Add an AudioParameterFloat over
  NormalisableRange&lt;float&gt;(0.0f, 100.0f, 0.1f, 2.0f), default 25.0f. Do not apply it to
  audio here — 01-02 owns the shaper.</action>
  <verify>cmake --build build --config Release && ctest --test-dir build -R Drive</verify>
  <fails_when>build error, or any ctest line reports Failed, or exit code != 0</fails_when>
  <done>Host shows a Drive parameter, 0..100%, default 25%</done>
</task>

## Must-haves
- [ ] Drive parameter visible to the host with the stated range and default

## Try it
Build `Widget_Standalone`, open it, and confirm Drive appears in the parameter list at 25%.
